title: Duplication allowance
description: The duplication policy for the implementation. The scanner fingerprints AST shape with identifiers normalised, so two functions of the same shape returning different fields register as identical while sharing no logic at all. Shape is therefore not the subject: duplication matters where one behaviour is implemented twice, or where two sites must stay aligned because they derive one value or hold one resource. A minimum size is what separates the two with this tool, because structural identity across a substantial body is copied logic while structural identity across an accessor is the shape every accessor has. Below the minimum the scanner is not consulted; at or above it the gate is zero and this file names no exemption. allowedConstants answers the constant census, which exists because the scanner carries no unit kind for a constant and so cannot see one at any threshold.
rationale: Eight exemptions stood here until 2026-08-05 and every one of them described the same non-issue: accessors, trait methods a trait requires separately, and match arms mapping unrelated enums to their own strings. None duplicated a behaviour and none held a value another site had to match, so the gate was spending written decisions to permit coincidence, and each new pair of small functions owed another one. The operator's rule retired them: similar code that can duplicate no resource, threaten no integrity and copy no seam is not a problem. What replaced them is a size below which this scanner is not asked, because a filter that cannot identify its own subject either matches nothing or matches the wrong thing, and this one could not tell a copied body from a shared shape. The threshold was measured rather than guessed on 2026-08-05: eight groups at the tool's default, two at five lines, none at eight, and every group that fell away was a coincidence named above. A tuned threshold was refused once before, on the ground that it also dropped the duplication that motivated adopting a scanner. That duplication was three constants, which the census below owns and which no function threshold ever reached, so the refusal does not reach this split. An exemption appearing here again is a decision to argue in review: at this size, structural identity is copied logic.
